title: 'Dunbar’s number' deconstructed
author: Lindenfors, Patrik and Wartel, Andreas and Lind, Johan
extracted_finding: Primate extrapolations give imprecise and model-dependent estimates.
principal_limitation: Does not establish unlimited personal relationships.

title: Calling Dunbar’s Numbers
author: Mac Carron, Pádraig and Kaski, Kimmo and Dunbar, Robin
extracted_finding: Telephone contacts show layered structure with variation.
principal_limitation: Preprint abstract inspected; a communication proxy is not every kind of tie.

title: Ingroup favoritism in cooperation: a meta-analysis
author: Balliet, Daniel and Wu, Junhui and De Dreu, Carsten K. W.
extracted_finding: Published standardized cooperation advantage d=0.32; dependence moderates it.
principal_limitation: No full-text bias or effect extraction audit; no new meta-analysis.

title: The coevolution of cultural groups and ingroup favoritism
author: Efferson, Charles and Lalive, Rafael and Fehr, Ernst
extracted_finding: Markers became informative about behavior in an experimental coordination setting.
principal_limitation: Arbitrary laboratory groups do not reproduce racialization or national politics.

title: The relational self: an interpersonal social-cognitive theory
author: Andersen, Susan M. and Chen, Serena
extracted_finding: Significant-other representations offer a candidate account of responses to new people.
principal_limitation: Theory abstract cannot establish coalition-scale effects.

title: Social Identity Complexity: Its Correlates and Antecedents
author: Miller, Kevin P. and Brewer, Marilynn B. and Arbuckle, Nathan L.
extracted_finding: Three studies examine identity complexity and attitudes or antecedents.
principal_limitation: Associations and experimental antecedents are distinct causal questions.

title: Why Does Ethnic Diversity Undermine Public Goods Provision?
author: Habyarimana, James and Humphreys, Macartan and Posner, Daniel N. and Weinstein, Jeremy M.
extracted_finding: Kampala games favor strategy selection and enforcement explanations over common tastes.
principal_limitation: Partner assignment varies; whole-community ethnicity is not randomized.

title: Building social cohesion between Christians and Muslims through soccer in post-ISIS Iraq
author: Mousa, Salma
extracted_finding: Collaborative teams improved specified peer behaviors; broader transfer was limited.
principal_limitation: Selected male sports participants and context; null transfer is not proof of zero effect.

title: Types of Contact: A Field Experiment on Collaborative and Adversarial Caste Integration
author: Lowe, Matt
extracted_finding: Collaborative and adversarial cricket contact had different social and trade effects.
principal_limitation: Full-text download returned 403; estimates and attrition not independently audited.

title: The contact hypothesis re-evaluated
author: Paluck, Elizabeth Levy and Green, Seth A. and Green, Donald P.
extracted_finding: Delayed randomized contact evidence has uneven population coverage and small-study concerns.
principal_limitation: Corpus reflects its search period; not an up-to-2026 census.

title: Reshaping Institutions: Evidence on Aid Impacts Using a Preanalysis Plan
author: Casey, Katherine and Glennerster, Rachel and Miguel, Edward
claim_locator: Abstract; results on family A and family B outcomes; conclusion
extracted_finding: Some project gains occurred without sustained changes in broader institutions studied.
principal_limitation: One program and observation window; does not show every participatory program fails.

title: Collective Action in Diverse Sierra Leone Communities
author: Glennerster, Rachel and Miguel, Edward and Rothenberg, Alexander D.
claim_locator: Abstract; empirical results and instrumental-variable discussion
extracted_finding: Local diversity did not predict worse public goods in the studied setting.
principal_limitation: Historical instrument needs an exclusion restriction; estimates remain context-specific.

title: Beyond Markets and States: Polycentric Governance of Complex Economic Systems
author: Ostrom, Elinor
publication: Revised Nobel lecture draft; later published in 2010
claim_locator: p. 13, design principle 8; wider governance discussion
extracted_finding: Nested tasks and multiple decision centers are proposed for complex resource governance.
principal_limitation: The retrieved draft is a theoretical synthesis, not a national regime experiment.

title: The Division of Labor in Society
author: Durkheim, Émile
extracted_finding: Likeness and differentiated interdependence are distinct accounts of solidarity.
principal_limitation: Excerpt only; conceptual distinction is not an automatic harmony claim.

title: Atlanta Exposition Address
author: Washington, Booker T.
publication: 18 September; reproduced speech with editorial introduction
claim_locator: Speech and separately identified editorial introduction
extracted_finding: Public economic cooperation accommodated social separation; editor notes private legal support.
principal_limitation: Private litigation claim rests on editorial account, not inspected correspondence.

title: The Souls of Black Folk
author: Du Bois, W. E. B.
publication: Chapter III: Of Mr. Booker T. Washington and Others
claim_locator: Chapter III, numbered demands near end
extracted_finding: Criticism includes voting rights, civic equality, and appropriate education.
principal_limitation: One period and chapter cannot represent the full evolution of Du Bois.

title: Speech at the OAAU founding rally
author: {Malcolm X}
claim_locator: Membership, independent organization, and international linkage passages
extracted_finding: Independent Black organization is placed within a wider international strategy.
principal_limitation: Programmatic speech; no estimated causal effectiveness.

title: Poor People’s Campaign
author: {The Martin Luther King, Jr. Research and Education Institute}
extracted_finding: The campaign pursued multiracial economic mobilization and achieved constrained results.
principal_limitation: Institutional secondary summary; no matched strategy counterfactual.

title: The Combahee River Collective Statement
author: {Combahee River Collective}
extracted_finding: Specific oppression and coalition commitments coexist; separatism is criticized.
principal_limitation: Normative and organizational statement, not an outcome study.

title: The Balfour Declaration
author: Balfour, Arthur James
extracted_finding: Imperial national-home statement with specified rights protections in its wording.
principal_limitation: Text alone does not evaluate implementation, present law, or constitutional alternatives.

title: Neo-Colonialism, the Last Stage of Imperialism
author: Nkrumah, Kwame
claim_locator: Chapter 2, continental planning and uneven benefits passages
extracted_finding: Continental economic coordination is advocated with uneven gains acknowledged.
principal_limitation: Primary political argument; the projected alternative was not experimentally tested.

title: SUNY Press publishes new edition of classic work on African American toasts
author: Gambini, Bert
publication: University at Buffalo; 27 February; interview with Bruce Jackson
claim_locator: Interview discussion of toasts and collection
extracted_finding: Identifies the oral form relevant to the project’s cultural example.
principal_limitation: This record is an interview, not a claim to have read Jackson’s full book.

title: Rappers Reflect on the Enduring Hip-Hop Legacy of Dolemite Comedian Rudy Ray Moore
author: Chow, Andrew R.
extracted_finding: Named artists describe Moore’s influence.
principal_limitation: Interview testimony does not establish a single origin of rap.

title: Afropessimism, or Black Studies as a Class Project
author: Reed, Adolph, Jr.
extracted_finding: Challenges essentialized accounts of racial politics through political-economic argument.
principal_limitation: Publication date not confirmed; argument is not a causal effect estimate.

title: Elite Capture: How the Powerful Took Over Identity Politics (and Everything Else)
author: Táíwò, Olúfẹ́mi O.
extracted_finding: Relevant lead for organizational power and representation.
principal_limitation: Full book not assessed; not used as decisive evidence.

title: Kwame Anthony Appiah on Identity, Stories, and Cosmopolitanism
author: Carroll, Sean and Appiah, Kwame Anthony
extracted_finding: Universal concern can coexist with particular attachments in the argument presented.
principal_limitation: Interview explains a normative position; does not test political effectiveness.

title: The Slave Trade and the Origins of Mistrust in Africa
author: Nunn, Nathan and Wantchekon, Leonard
claim_locator: Author metadata; indexed NBER w14783 abstract
extracted_finding: Historical exploitation and present trust are investigated empirically.
principal_limitation: NBER direct access failed; no full-text identification audit; slave trade is not identical to colonial partition.

title: Social Identity Complexity
author: Roccas, Sonia and Brewer, Marilynn B.
claim_locator: Indexed abstract; direct page timed out
extracted_finding: Perceived overlap among memberships is proposed as a distinct construct.
principal_limitation: Theory discovery record only; not a causal organizational result.

title: Worldmaking after Empire: The Rise and Fall of Self-Determination
author: Getachew, Adom
claim_locator: Introduction, international order and federation discussion
extracted_finding: Anticolonial projects are interpreted as attempts to reconstruct international order.
principal_limitation: Introduction inspected; complete book and underlying archive not assessed.

title: From Redistribution to Recognition? Dilemmas of Justice in a 'Post-Socialist' Age
author: Fraser, Nancy
extracted_finding: Recognition and redistribution are framed as related justice problems.
principal_limitation: URL returned HTML excerpt; full article not accessed.

title: Ella Baker
author: {SNCC Digital Gateway}
claim_locator: Organizing approach and grassroots leadership discussion
extracted_finding: Profile emphasizes participatory grassroots organizing.
principal_limitation: Secondary profile; linked oral histories were not examined.

title: Beyond Vietnam: A Time to Break Silence
author: King, Martin Luther, Jr.
publication: 4 April; Riverside Church; Civil Rights Movement Archive transcript
claim_locator: Opening reasons; concluding discussion of values and global obligations
extracted_finding: King connects antiwar commitments with poverty, racism, and obligations beyond nationality.
principal_limitation: A speech establishes stated commitments, not the effects of that strategy.

title: The Ballot or the Bullet
author: {Malcolm X}
publication: April; transcript hosted by Ruhr University Bochum
claim_locator: Community economy, voting, and human-rights passages
extracted_finding: Community control and international human-rights appeals coexist with electoral demands.
principal_limitation: Multiple speech versions exist; no claim this captures every 1964 or later position.

title: Aliens and Citizens: The Case for Open Borders
author: Carens, Joseph H.
extracted_finding: Liberal theories are used to argue for open borders.
principal_limitation: University PDF retrieval failed; no labor-market effect estimate follows from this normative abstract.

title: The Pan-African Congress
author: Du Bois, W. E. B.
publication: Cayton’s Weekly, 19 April; reproduced by World History Commons
extracted_finding: Report documents a transnational forum containing differing arguments about rights and representation.
principal_limitation: Not collated against newspaper image; hosting page has a Clayton/Cayton spelling inconsistency.
